salesforce:replay-channel-listener.doc:name: Listen for Salesforce Contact CDC Events

ee:transform.doc:name: Normalize Contact CDC Event and Initialize Context

logger.doc:name: Log Contact CDC Event Receipt
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_CDC_EVENT_RECEIVED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", changeType: vars.changeType default "UNKNOWN", channel: vars.cdcChannel default "NOT_AVAILABLE" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Salesforce CDC Replay Identifier
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_CDC_REPLAY_ID_RECEIVED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", channel: vars.cdcChannel default "NOT_AVAILABLE" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Validation Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "PROCESS_VALIDATION_FAILED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "MULE") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "VALIDATION"), description: error.description default "Validation failed" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Expression Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "PROCESS_EXPRESSION_ERROR", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "MULE") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "EXPRESSION"), description: error.description default "Expression processing failed" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Unexpected Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "PROCESS_UNEXPECTED_ERROR", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "MULE") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), description: error.description default "Unexpected processing failure" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Contact Processing Start
Log Contact Processing Completion
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_ONBOARDING_PROCESSING_COMPLETED", correlationId: vars.correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.contactId default "UNKNOWN", replayId: vars.replayId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactPriority: vars.contactPriority default "NORMAL" }, "application/json")]
